mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side conditions, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 100k and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% and RSAFS declines > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% and UNRATE declines > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.
